name: Madaëf
full_name: Madaëf — Moroccan Agency for Tourism Development
description: Madaëf is Morocco's leading state-owned hotel development and management company, created under the CDG Group (Caisse de Dépôt et de Gestion) to develop and manage the tourism infrastructure assets of Morocco's major resort destinations. As the principal vehicle for state investment in hospitality real estate, Madaëf owns and manages an extensive portfolio of hotels across Morocco's most strategically important tourism zones including Taghazout Bay, Saidia, Al Hoceima, Tamuda Bay, El Jadida, and Marrakech. The agency's mandate combines commercial hotel operations with the broader mission of developing Morocco's tourism infrastructure in line with the kingdom's national tourism strategy, Vision 2030, and the objectives of the Plan Azur resort development program. Madaëf operates through a mixed model of direct management and international brand management agreements, partnering with global operators including Accor, Marriott, Hyatt, Hilton, Radisson, and Club Med to bring international standards to its portfolio while maintaining state ownership of the underlying assets.

name: Risma
full_name: Risma S.A. — Société d'Investissement et de Management Hôtelier
description: Risma is Morocco's only publicly listed hotel company, traded on the Casablanca Stock Exchange, and the country's largest hotel operator by number of properties. Operating as the master franchisee of Accor brands in Morocco, Risma manages a diversified portfolio spanning the luxury Sofitel and MGallery brands down to the economy Ibis family, making it the most vertically integrated hotel operator in the kingdom. The company's portfolio is concentrated in Morocco's primary business and tourism destinations including Casablanca, Rabat, Marrakech, Agadir, and Fes, with a strong emphasis on the midscale and economy segments that serve the country's large domestic corporate travel market. As a listed entity, Risma provides one of the rare windows into publicly disclosed hotel operating performance in Morocco, making it a key reference point for market benchmarking and investment analysis.

name: Al Mada
description: Al Mada is one of Morocco's largest and most diversified investment holding companies with significant interests across financial services, industry, retail, agriculture, and hospitality. In the hotel sector, Al Mada operates through Atlas Hospitality Group, a wholly owned subsidiary that has emerged as one of the largest Moroccan-owned hotel operators in the kingdom by total room count. The group's hospitality portfolio spans luxury resorts, upscale urban hotels, midscale business properties, and branded residential developments across Morocco's primary destinations including Casablanca, Marrakech, Agadir, Fes, and Tétouan. Atlas Hospitality Group's combination of internationally branded properties under The View collection and domestically branded assets under the Atlas and Relax Hotels banners reflects Al Mada's strategy of building a vertically integrated hospitality platform that serves multiple market segments simultaneously.

name: Valeria Hotels
description: Valeria Hotels is a Moroccan independent hotel group specializing in large-scale club resort properties targeting the European all-inclusive leisure market. Operating exclusively within Morocco, Valeria has built a significant resort portfolio concentrated in Marrakech's Palmeraie district and Agadir, with properties that combine extensive leisure facilities, entertainment programming, and all-inclusive packages tailored to family and group travelers. The group's Marrakech properties in the Palmeraie have established Valeria as one of the largest resort operators in the city's leisure segment, while the Agadir property serves the Atlantic coast's strong European charter market. Valeria's most recent addition, the Valeria Kasbah del Mar in Cabo Negro on the Mediterranean coast, signals the group's ambition to expand into Morocco's emerging northern resort corridor.

name: Tikida Group
description: Tikida Group is a Moroccan family-owned hospitality company and one of the largest private hotel owners in the kingdom, with a portfolio concentrated in Agadir and Marrakech. The group operates in partnership with TUI Hotels & Resorts for the majority of its properties, with TUI managing the Robinson Club and Tikida-branded resorts under its global all-inclusive concept. This long-standing partnership with one of Europe's largest travel groups has established Tikida as the dominant resort owner in Agadir, capturing a significant share of the city's European leisure tourism capacity. The group's flagship independent property, the Tikida Golf Palace in Agadir, operates outside the TUI partnership and represents the group's own luxury positioning in the upscale golf and leisure resort segment.

name: Pickalbatros
description: Pickalbatros is an Egyptian hospitality group operating a portfolio of upscale and upper upscale all-inclusive resorts across North Africa and the Middle East, with a growing presence in Morocco. The group's Morocco portfolio is concentrated in Marrakech and Agadir, where it operates six large-scale resort properties ranging from family-oriented all-inclusive clubs to adults-only beachfront resorts and golf properties. Pickalbatros targets the European and regional leisure travel market with a consistent all-inclusive product offering that combines extensive amenities, entertainment programming, and prime resort locations. The group's expansion into Morocco reflects its confidence in the country's growing appeal as a year-round leisure destination for European and Middle Eastern travelers.
